name: Autocomplete
layerWhy: One field with suggested answers; still one question.
promise: Typing narrows a list of answers; with [strict], only one of them is a valid answer.
expectation: A text field that opens a list on focus or click, marking what matches the words typed.
evidence: Matches are marked, a status says how many, an empty result says so; a search box opens on focus with its own blank list.
behaviour: Opens on click, ↓, or on focus with [openOnFocus].
[blank] options show while the field is empty.
Text that differs only by case or accents becomes the option on leaving.
context: Cities, people, pages: a long list someone partly knows. Search boxes.
relationships: Typing narrows; the chosen answer is the field's value.
accessibility: combobox with aria-autocomplete="list"; the count is announced.
failures: Never blank while it has something to offer.
do: Give a search box a blank list.
dont: Strict on a field where any answer is valid.
